audit.why: Even-to-slightly-favoured lane (52.06% WR, 924 games): Akshan bullies levels 1-2, Qiyana takes over from 3 onward, snowballs through picks; page already frames it this way.
Spikes: level 3 (all elements + E), level 6 (Supreme Display beats Comeuppance channel when Heroic Swing down), first item one-combo. Content spikes[] has all four entries and matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet chart both say Akshan L1-2, Qiyana from L3. Cooldowns field had no number. Interactions themselves are sound: Heroic Swing (E, 18s rank 1) is his only engage/escape; Avengerang (Q, 9s early) double-passes; his three-hit passive shields him; Qiyana R is a projectile his kit cannot block.
audit.why: Chart rule: full side and content win must agree; content and packet agree with each other, so full sides are the stale layer.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Akshan/Akshan/Qiyana x5 with whys rewritten to match; real cooldown numbers (E 18s->12s, Q 9s->5s, R 120s) written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: Title promises one thing, body explains another.
audit.corrected: New bodies grounded in his three-hit passive and open-ground kiting.

edits.before: Grass Q from the river brush line — the stealth-empowered poke chunks and the lane learns to fear hedges.
edits.after: Avengerang's out-and-back double hit plus his three-hit passive shield bully you before an element loads.

edits.before: W element economy begins: ice for the trades, rock for the executes, grass for the angles.
edits.after: Still his — he weaves autos and Q passes you cannot yet answer without an attuned element.

edits.before: E joins: the stick-dash into ice-Q root is your first real kill pattern — pick one window per wave.
edits.after: E joins and the lane flips to you: E-ice-Q root is your first real kill pattern — pick one window per wave.

edits.before: Element-cycle the trades: E-ice-Q roots, auto, rock-Q the execute line. The lane is a terrain quiz.
edits.after: You dictate now: E-ice-Q roots, auto, rock-Q the execute line — he answers a terrain quiz every trade.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: Supreme Display online — your all-in bursts him before Comeuppance channels, so any wall fight is yours to rig.

edits.before: First item spike: the full element string deletes squishies. Force the brush-line fights.
edits.after: First item: your full string one-combos him from brush stealth before his passive shield procs.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: You stay ahead late: he fades in solo duels versus your burst, and his revive is wasted on a dead target.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Terrashape (element swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1, 12s max — his only engage and escape. Step up the moment it is spent; the window is long. - Avengerang (Q) sits on 9s early: dodge one pass, then trade. - Budget your R (120s) for endings, never openers.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Brush stealth resets his three-hit passive count — Q from grass and slip back in before the third hit, so his shield never procs.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Open ground is his: Avengerang double-passes you and Heroic Swing kites your E. Drag every duel to brush or a wall.

notes: Content layer and packet chart already agreed (Akshan L1-2, Qiyana from L3); only the full-layer sides carried blanket 'Skill', so side+why were flipped with no win[N] edits (no-ops would be rejected). Ratings left at 5-6/10 — plausible for a 52% lane. report[] left alone apart from none needed; report[3]/[4] duplicate trade/wave strings by design. Spell-shield/QSS behaviour of Qiyana R stun not asserted (not in kit text).
